description: APEX Countersign: check a stablecoin payment before you send it, on Base, Ethereum, Arc, BNB Chain, Solana or X1. Reads the OFAC SDN list (from US Treasury), USDC/USDT issuer freezes on chain, the official stablecoin contract, EIP-55 checksum and burn addresses, lookalikes of payees you already pay, and on Arc the poison index of USDC transfers since 27 Oct 2026. Answers ALLOW / REVIEW / DENY / COULD_NOT_READ with every check and its source, EIP-712 signed; an unread source is never ALLOW. Pass requirement to check an x402 402 response as it arrived. 20 free a day, then $0.005 over x402 (pass payment). With a Countersign key (plans from $9/month at https://apexfaucet.xyz/countersign/) your approved payee book, caps and review queue apply and the check goes into your signed audit log.

amount.description: optional: amount in the asset units (dollars for a stablecoin)

asset.description: optional: the token contract being paid

chain.description: base, ethereum, arc, bnb, solana or x1 (x402 network ids like eip155:8453 work)

key.description: optional: your Countersign key (csk_...) to apply your account rules and log

known.description: optional: comma-separated payees you already pay (a lookalike of one is DENY)

payTo.description: the address you are about to pay (0x on EVM chains, base58 on Solana/X1)

payment.description: optional: a signed x402 payment (base64, as in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE) once the free checks are used up

requirement.description: optional: the x402 402 JSON body or base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, as received; pass chain too (the chain you will pay on); payTo, asset and amount are then read from it
